implications.exact_graph_connector: IMPOSSIBLE. An exact reflected OT Einstein connector cannot reach the expanding tail interface (e → 0). The center identity forces ⟨e⟩ = 12+⟨h²⟩≥12, while the Bochner maximum principle controls the interior by the exit and 6. This explains why the K-production analysis and all numerical core-entry searches produced only apparent obstructions: the exact problem has no solution.
implications.approximate_connector: The tension identity shows the forced divergence term div_σ(V) is the precise obstacle. Its integrated form is controllable (−|F|² + cross terms), but the pointwise form involves DF. The stability question is whether Moser iteration on the weighted base gives geometry-independent L∞ bounds.
implications.NxN_route: For M = N#N with N hyperbolic, A01 confirms the BCG+CGB threshold δ ~ 3/(4χ(N)). The S³ neck topology differs from the T³-based OT analysis. The Bochner comparison applies to any OT orbit-map energy, but the connected-sum neck has collapsing T² orbits at axis points, requiring different orbit analysis.
implications.K_production_comparison: The K-production analysis tracks the z-averaged tangential orbit energy. The Bochner comparison tracks the full 2D energy density pointwise. At the center, K=⟨e−h²⟩=12 and hence ⟨e⟩≥12, so Bochner is strictly stronger: it gives an interior bound from the exit directly contradicting the center average for low-energy exits. The K-production framework was analyzing a question that has no solution in the exact case. For the forced case, K-production captures the z-averaged deficit while Bochner captures the pointwise; they are complementary.

step83_corrections.drift_sign: Step 83 §5 used Ric_B + Hess σ (Bakry-Émery convention). Correct is Ric_B − Hess σ (drift Laplacian convention). This changes the sign of the orbit-stress contribution.
step83_corrections.benchmark: Step 83 used γ_B = dr²+cosh²(r)dz² with σ=2r as benchmark. This is not an exact Einstein base metric: E_B_{zz} = 2−2tanh(r) ≠ 0. Correct benchmark: γ_B = dr²+e^{2r}dz², σ=2r.
step83_corrections.eigenvalue: Step 83 claimed universal radial eigenvalue −1 for Ric^σ. With the correct convention: Ric−Hess σ ON = diag(−1,−3) on the cusp. This is −3γ + ½dσ², not a universal eigenvalue structure.
step83_corrections.closed_geodesic: Step 83 §3 mentioned closed geodesic in H². No nonconstant closed geodesic exists in H² (curvature < 0). Every nonconstant closed center loop has nonzero tension.
step83_corrections.conclusion_change: Step 83 concluded Bochner route does NOT close. After correction: Bochner route gives a COMPLETE obstruction for exact connectors and a precise stability question for forced ones.
